title: Client-limited pin & priming lab — scratch notes
content:
Context / objective:
- Client: AcmePay (large multi-tenant integration). They want model flip from text-gen-v1 -> text-gen-v2-qa (quantized).
- Primary goals: no visible user regressions, keep 99th latency within 1.5x baseline, error rate < 0.1% user-facing, and cost per 1k tokens <= 1.1x current.
- Secondary: capture warmup behaviour (KV cache, batching) so Dedicated pools don’t thrash.

Summary plan (high level):
1) Shadow + passive warmup (3 hours) — route 100% shadow traffic to v2 (no client exposure) to build KV caches, observe batching rates and OOMs.
2) Seed cohort (0.05% traffic) — sticky cohort seeded from least-sensitive tenants (alpha clients) for 1 hour.
3) Staggered pin: 0.05% -> 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Each step minimum 30m, recommended 60m for steps >=2%.
4) Rollback triggers and automated guardrails. Manual approval required at 10% and 40% gates.

Detailed rollout timeline (day-of):
- T-24h: Pre-check: confirm model bundle signed, checksum, quantization bits documented. Post kube image tag in thread.
- T-3h: Run synthetic warmup (loadgen small set) to ensure warm paths. Start shadowing for 3h.
- T-0h: Start seed cohort at 00:00 UTC (0.05%). Observe.
- T+1h: If green, escalate to 0.5%
- T+2h: If green, escalate to 2%
- T+4h: If green, escalate to 10% (manual approval required)
- T+8h: If green, escalate to 40% (manual approval)
- T+12h: If green, flip to 100% or schedule gradual follow-on over next 24h depending on customer preferences.

Metric watchlist (dashboards & thresholds):
- HTTP / gRPC 5xx rate (global): trigger if > 0.2% over 5m window.
- Client-visible error rate (per-tenant): trigger if > 0.1% sustained 10m.
- Tail latency p99 (per-region & per-model): trigger if > 1.5x baseline for 5m.
- Queue length / request backlog (ingress proxy): trigger if > baseline + 50% for 10m.
- GPU memory pressure / OOM rate: immediate trigger to pause pin.
- Output quality signals: drop in rerank scores or increase in hallucination flags from QA probe set > 5% relative.

Automated fallback rules (to configure before run):
- If HTTP 5xx > 0.5% global for 1m -> immediate switch traffic away to fallback model-v1 across affected region.
- If p99 > 2x baseline for 3m -> reduce traffic to v2 by half automatically, alert SRE.
- If per-tenant error > 0.5% for 5m -> remove tenant from v2 cohort and mark for investigation.

Pinning & routing mechanics notes:
- Use per-tenant pin via routing header X-Model-Pin: text-gen-v2-qa for seeded cohort. For SDK-driven clients, flip via feature-flag (ff-redwood: client-acmepay-pin).
- Console path: Route table > Add rule (tenant-id hash range) -> target model text-gen-v2-qa. Double-check hit ratio in console (route simulation).
- For Dedicated pools: ensure model variant exists on pool. If not, pre-stage image on GPUs (pre-pull) 6h prior.
- For sticky sessions: confirm TTL of pin cookie (cookie-based routing) is 7d by default; set shorter (24h) for early rollout.

Warmup instructions (practical):
- Shadowing will populate KV cache; additionally run synthetic priming: 2k representative prompts (sampled across top 20 tenants) at 0.2 RPS per prompt over 15m. These prompts mimic user prefixes — include long context to exercise KV.
- Batch/concurrency ramp: start with batch_target=8, concurrency=12; observe overall batch fill rate. If average batch size < 3 for first 30m, increase concurrency to 24 to encourage batching.
- Tokenization corner cases: run tokenizer fuzz for 1k synthetic long inputs to ensure no tokenization regressions on v2 quantized codepath.

Observability & escalation path:
- Slack: post status updates to #releases and #sre-oncall. Pager to SRE oncall if p99 or 5xx triggers.
- Dashboards: Release > Canary > AcmePay-cohort (p95/p99, errors, GPU_util, queue_length, cost/tokens).
- Logs: add temporary trace_id mapping for the seeded cohort: header X-Canary-Tag. Keep traces for 1w.

Checklist (day-of quick):
- [ ] Confirm model artifact sha + console model listing.
- [ ] Pre-pull model image on Dedicated nodes.
- [ ] Shadow traffic run started and stable for 3h.
- [ ] Seed cohort list confirmed (tenant ids) and FF set.
- [ ] Observability panels up and alert thresholds loaded.
- [ ] SRE and CS on standby for approval gates.
- [ ] Post-mortem template created in GH issue.

Escape hatches (quick ops steps):
- Immediate rollback (fast): run console route rollback -> revert route table to previous commit (button). Notify CS and change log.
- Soft rollback (targeted): remove tenants from v2 by removing header routing rule.
- Emergency: scale up fallback pool capacity (reserve surge) and divert traffic (smart routing rule fallback to region-b).

Client-specific quirks for AcmePay:
- Many high-context payment flows: prefer p95 under 400ms. They are sensitive to hallucination on confirmation IDs.
- Data residency: some tenants require EU-only routing — watch region split.
- Their SDK caches model config locally; coordinate CS to push SDK toggle for immediate pin change if needed.

Open questions / TODOs (my personal):
- [ ] Confirm list of tenant IDs for seed cohort from CS (emailed Priya, awaiting list).
- [ ] Ask model team for explicit quantization artifacts: padding behaviour and kv-cache compatibility doc.
- [ ] Run a 1h soak on Dedicated pool with small synthetic workload to stress eviction behaviour.
- [ ] Confirm cost reporting delta on per-10k-token basis (finance signoff).
- [ ] Add unit test for route-simulation to ensure tenant-hash mapping is deterministic across rollouts.

Quick snippets / commands:
- Toggle FF for seed cohort (CLI): redwoodctl ff set client-acmepay-pin true --scope tenants:acmepay-seed
- Simulate route match (console API): curl -H 'X-Tenant: acmepay-42' -H 'X-Model-Pin: text-gen-v2-qa' https://console.internal.redwood/api/route/simulate
- Remove tenant from v2 quickly: redwoodctl routes remove-rule --tenant acmepay-42 --model text-gen-v2-qa

Notes to self (style / why these numbers):
- Small seed (0.05%) to test TTLs and sticky pins without exposing many users; gives statistically useful sample for error rate.
- 10% and 40% as manual gates because above 10% we start to see aggregated infra effects (batching and GPU tail behaviour), and 40%+ can saturate a cluster if not pre-warmed.

Post-roll observations to capture (after successful flip):
- Batch size distribution before/after flip.
- Cold-start error occurrences vs warm.
- Per-tenant cost shift and token efficiency.
- Any model-specific failure modes (OOM, nan logits, truncation).

If I have time before run:
- Build a tiny smoke harness that hits high-risk endpoints (confirmations, refunds) for AcmePay and validate output shape + key tokens.
- Add a synthetic reranking suite to flag quality regressions (delta on gold set).

End of scratchpad.
(Will refine after conversation with Priya and Liam — escalate to formal runbook when we have tenant list and signoff.)
